snippet.title: Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted – Pre-order Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on Oct 23, 2025! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/plants-vs-zombies-replanted-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Plants vs. Zombies is back in glorious HD! A familiar lawn. A familiar threat. A whole lot of nostalgia. Use an arsenal of quirky plants to fend off waves of hilarious zombies in Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted.

This Remaster of the OG Plants vs. Zombies experience is a tribute to the classics. The same charm, chaos, and sun-powered defense players know and love. Whether you grew up with Peashooters or just met Crazy Dave, this one's for the fans.

#PlantsVsZombiesReplanted #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect
